scripts.build: bun run validate && cd apps/game && bun run build
scripts.typecheck: (cd packages/shared && tsc --noEmit) && (cd apps/game && tsc --noEmit) && (cd apps/server && tsc --noEmit) && tsc -p tools --noEmit
scripts.e2e: for t in ep0 ep1 ep2 ep3 ep4 features; do echo "== $t"; node tools/e2e/$t.mjs || exit 1; done
